originalTitle: AI stock swings could affect your 401(k). Here’s what retirement savers need to know
summary: Retirement savers may be affected by swings in the artificial intelligence trade. Here is how to assess the risk without making a rash move.
content:
The AI trade has been volatile this week as investors weigh questions about the pace of artificial intelligence development, capacity constraints and safety concerns. Even if you do not own an individual AI stock or AI-themed fund, the swings may still affect your retirement savings .

A "slowdown" in AI innovation, adaptation or use "could have some downstream implications for the companies that might be in the average 401(k) investor's portfolio," said John Sedunov, a professor of finance at Villanova University.

The reason: Many 401(k) investors already have meaningful exposure to the companies driving the AI boom.

Five technology giants — Nvidia , Apple , Microsoft , Alphabet and Amazon — account for about 30% of the S&P 500 index, as of Wednesday's market close, according to Morningstar. For the millions of workers who have a portion of their retirement savings invested in an S&P 500 index fund, that means a relatively small group of mega-cap companies can have an outsized effect on stock returns.

Here's a look at more stories on how to manage, grow and protect your money for the years ahead.

"A slowdown would represent a pullback in some of the AI stocks or the large-cap technology stocks that make up a large portion of investors' portfolios today," said Zachary Evens, a manager research analyst for Morningstar, because of the concentration within S&P 500 index funds that can make up a large share of their 401(k).

That doesn't mean an S&P 500 index fund isn't diversified. The index owns hundreds of companies across sectors. Still, when a few stocks grow to represent such a large share of the index, experts say, investors should understand the concentration risk that can come with broad-market investing.

AI exposure can extend beyond the biggest tech names

AI exposure is not limited to the household names at the center of a nearly four-year-long U.S. stock market rally. It can also show up in companies that supply chips, power, data centers and other infrastructure for the AI buildout — including industrial and smaller companies.

"The AI infrastructure build has so many different elements on the supply chain that you can be looking at something as far afield as industrials or within the small-cap space, and have AI exposure," said Marta Norton, chief investment strategist at Empower.

It may also be inside target-date funds , the default investment option in many 401(k) plans. Those funds typically hold a mix of stocks and bonds, and gradually become more conservative as investors approach retirement. Their stock allocations can still include the S&P 500 index and other funds with exposure to AI-linked companies.

"With target-date investors, the asset allocation varies over time, and so as you shift from equity to fixed income, some of that AI exposure will come down naturally," Norton said. "Still, the lion's share of that growth exposure is attached in many ways to AI, because it's a U.S. portfolio and the U.S. market is attached to AI."

If the AI buildout slows or investors become less enthusiastic about the potential payoff, experts say, retirement savers could see more market volatility. Still, that does not mean a 401(k) is entirely riding on the AI trade.

"Nine times out of 10, all of your money is not at risk with AI," said Nicolas Abrams, a certified financial planner and CEO of investment advisory firm Opulentia in Hunt Valley, Maryland . "Even if there is some volatility in the AI play, you've got a whole portfolio of other investments out there."

Many diversified 401(k) funds also own other stocks and bonds. The appropriate response to a volatile market is generally not to make a sudden change, Abrams said, but to make sure your holdings and risk level still fit your plan.

1. Look beyond your fund's name. A fund described as a broad U.S. stock fund, an S&P 500 index fund or a target-date fund may still have substantial exposure to the largest technology companies. Review the stocks that make up the fund.

"Dig down one layer below the top, and look at the top 10 or top 20 holdings across your ETFs in your portfolio, and try to get an understanding of how correlated those ETFs might be," Sedunov said.

2. Rebalance if you are overweight. Check whether your exposure to a particular stock, sector or fund has grown beyond your desired asset allocation. If it has, rebalancing can help bring the portfolio back to your intended mix.

"You might be overweight in large-cap stocks right now because of the run-up in the market," Abrams said. "It might be time to diversify that some and take some of that risk off the table and just rebalance your portfolio to make sure that you're allocated properly as an investor."

3. Consider a portfolio-bucketing approach. Experts say investors nearing or in retirement may want near-term spending needs in relatively stable assets, such as cash and bonds, while allowing longer-term growth investments more time to recover from market swings. The right time horizon and mix will differ depending on your retirement goal.

4. Keep your retirement goal in view. Moving to a more conservative portfolio may reduce volatility, Abrams said, but it can also lower expected returns. That may mean saving more, working longer, or adjusting spending expectations to stay on track.

The bottom line: Know what you own and the risks you are taking. Don't let short-term, AI-driven market volatility dictate a long-term decision about your retirement savings.
chineseTitle: AI 股票波动可能会影响您的 401(k)。这是退休储蓄者需要了解的内容
chineseSummary: 退休储蓄者可能会受到人工智能行业波动的影响。以下是如何评估风险而不采取鲁莽行动。
chineseContent:
由于投资者权衡人工智能发展速度、产能限制和安全担忧等问题，本周人工智能交易一直波动较大。即使您不拥有个人人工智能股票或人工智能主题基金，波动仍可能影响您的退休储蓄。

维拉诺瓦大学金融学教授约翰·塞杜诺夫 (John Sedunov) 表示，人工智能创新、适应或使用的“放缓”“可能会对普通 401(k) 投资者投资组合中的公司产生一些下游影响”。

原因是：许多 401(k) 投资者已经对推动人工智能繁荣的公司进行了有意义的投资。

根据晨星公司的数据，截至周三收盘，英伟达、苹果、微软、Alphabet 和亚马逊这五家科技巨头约占标准普尔 500 指数的 30%。对于将部分退休储蓄投资于标准普尔 500 指数基金的数百万工人来说，这意味着相对较小的一批大型公司可以对股票回报产生巨大影响。

以下是有关如何在未来几年管理、增长和保护您的资金的更多故事。

晨星公司的经理研究分析师 Zachary Evens 表示：“经济放缓意味着一些人工智能股票或大盘科技股的回调，这些股票构成了当今投资者投资组合的很大一部分。”因为标准普尔 500 指数基金集中在 401(k) 基金中，这些基金占据了很大一部分。

这并不意味着标准普尔 500 指数基金不多元化。该指数拥有数百家跨行业公司。不过，专家表示，当少数股票在指数中占据如此大的份额时，投资者应该了解大市场投资可能带来的集中风险。

人工智能的曝光范围不仅限于最大的科技公司

人工智能的曝光并不局限于美国股市近四年涨势中家喻户晓的名字。它还可能出现在为人工智能建设提供芯片、电力、数据中心和其他基础设施的公司中，包括工业公司和小型公司。

Empower 首席投资策略师玛尔塔·诺顿 (Marta Norton) 表示：“人工智能基础设施建设在供应链上有如此多不同的元素，你可以将目光投向工业或小盘股等更远的领域，并涉足人工智能领域。”

它也可能属于目标日期基金，这是许多 401(k) 计划中的默认投资选择。这些基金通常混合持有股票和债券，并随着投资者临近退休而逐渐变得更加保守。他们的股票配置仍然可以包括标准普尔 500 指数和其他投资于人工智能相关公司的基金。

诺顿说：“对于目标日期投资者来说，资产配置会随着时间的推移而变化，因此当你从股票转向固定收益时，一些人工智能风险敞口会自然下降。” “尽管如此，增长风险的最大份额在很多方面都与人工智能相关，因为它是美国的投资组合，而美国市场与人工智能相关。”

专家表示，如果人工智能建设放缓或投资者对其潜在回报的热情降低，退休储蓄者可能会看到更大的市场波动。尽管如此，这并不意味着 401(k) 完全依赖于人工智能行业。

马里兰州亨特谷投资咨询公司 Opulentia 的认证财务规划师兼首席执行官尼古拉斯·艾布拉姆斯 (Nicolas Abrams) 表示：“十分之九，人工智能不会让你的所有资金面临风险。” “即使人工智能领域存在一些波动，你也可以拥有一整套其他投资组合。”

许多多元化 401(k) 基金还拥有其他股票和债券。艾布拉姆斯表示，对波动市场的适当反应通常不是突然改变，而是确保你的持仓和风险水平仍然符合你的计划。

1.不要只关注基金名称。被描述为广泛的美国股票基金、标准普尔 500 指数基金或目标日期基金的基金可能仍对最大的科技公司有大量投资。查看组成基金的股票。

Sedunov 表示：“深入挖掘顶部之下的一层，查看投资组合中 ETF 的前 10 名或前 20 名持股，并尝试了解这些 ETF 的相关性如何。”

2. 如果您超重，请重新平衡。检查您对特定股票、行业或基金的投资是否超出了您期望的资产配置。如果是这样，重新平衡可以帮助使投资组合恢复到您预期的组合。

艾布拉姆斯表示：“由于市场上涨，你现在可能会增持大盘股。” “也许是时候进行多元化投资，并消除一些风险，重新平衡你的投资组合，以确保你作为投资者得到适当的分配。”

3. 考虑投资组合分桶方法。专家表示，即将退休或即将退休的投资者可能希望满足现金和债券等相对稳定资产的近期支出需求，同时让长期增长投资有更多时间从市场波动中恢复。正确的时间范围和组合将根据您的退休目标而有所不同。

4. 牢记您的退休目标。艾布拉姆斯表示，转向更保守的投资组合可能会减少波动性，但也会降低预期回报。这可能意味着增加储蓄、延长工作时间或调整支出预期以保持正轨。

底线：了解您拥有什么以及您正在承担的风险。不要让人工智能驱动的短期市场波动左右您的退休储蓄的长期决策。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
